summary: A personalized wellness platform that organizes physical, mental, and nutritional resources and recommends content based on each person's profile, preferences, and goals.
role: Product Owner · Brand & UX/UI Designer · Full-Stack Developer
galleryDescription: Visual identity built to feel calm and approachable — clear hierarchy, soft gradients, accessible layouts, and voice-guided exercise routines for a genuinely inclusive wellness experience.

processSteps.title: Know yourself
processSteps.description: User creates an account and completes a form about habits, preferences, goals, and declared needs — the foundation for every recommendation.

processSteps.title: Find a starting point
processSteps.description: A profile-based scoring engine processes the data and selects relevant content, reducing the burden of knowing where to begin.

processSteps.title: Your personal space
processSteps.description: "Mi Espacio" surfaces curated recommendations — exercises, meditations, meal plans — so users don't have to rebuild their search on every visit.

processSteps.title: Explore and return
processSteps.description: Users can follow suggestions, browse the blog, search by interest, or regenerate recommendations whenever they need fresh options.
